verdict.rationale: Superset orchestrates parallel coding agents in isolated worktrees, so a readiness check-and-fix feature is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions agent-readiness criteria, an assessment of them, or any automatic remediation of failing criteria. Prompting an agent or scheduling an automation to make such fixes would be a user-side workaround, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can automatically fix failing agent-readiness criteria in my repository
